result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly underdeveloped, lacking sidewalks, marked crossings, and any form of traffic control. Pedestrians are forced to share the degraded roadway with vehicles, and visibility is partially obscured by overgrown vegetation along the road edge.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks or designated walking paths forces pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Overgrown Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense brush on the left side of the road limits visibility and encroaches on the paved area.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt surface creates trip hazards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk to provide physical separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim and clear overgrown brush to improve sightlines and reclaim space for walking.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repave the roadway to provide a smooth, safe surface for all users.

result.summary: The image depicts a two-lane roadway completely devoid of pedestrian infrastructure, such as sidewalks, crosswalks, or street lighting. Pedestrians are forced to walk on the unpaved grassy shoulder or within the travel lanes, creating a high-risk environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or paved shoulder, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on uneven grass directly adjacent to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire left and right edges of the roadway.

hazards.name: Absence of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No luminaires are visible, which significantly reduces pedestrian visibility and safety during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Construct Sidewalks
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk separated from the roadway to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add street light poles to improve visibility for all road users at night.

interventions.title: Paved Shoulders
interventions.description: If full sidewalks are not feasible, provide wide, paved shoulders to offer some separation from motor vehicle traffic.

result.summary: The environment is a residential intersection lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or traffic control signs. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles, and large trees may obstruct sight lines at the corners.
